name: security-rdp-gateway-resource-binding-review
intent: RDP gateway identity, resource authorization and session lifecycle
artifacts: Gateway authentication, connection/resource policies, target selection and session revocation rules.
trace: Trace authenticated identity and approved target into the actual remote-session connection, including aliases and reconnect state.
experiment: Use owned lab targets or configuration proof with synthetic identities; compare an entitled target and one forbidden target/resource alias.
disproof: Gateway login or target discovery is not a desktop session; denial before connection is a meaningful control.
repair: Bind connection/resource policy to normalized targets and verify permitted reconnect and revocation.
branch_decisions: Distinguish gateway connection authorization, resource authorization and target host login. Passing one gateway policy does not establish access to every internal host or desktop session. Follow user/group conditions, selected resource and any session reconnection policy using supplied configuration or a lab, and preserve target authentication as a separate necessary edge.
